title: Multi Item Rating Scale for ward-specific Infection prevention Aspects (HyScore-0.1)
summary: This multicentric and prospective Study evaluates in 250 wards 10 infection control parameters: hand hygiene, glove use, clothing, clean surfaces and the safety of peripheral venous catheters. Using these 10 items, we seek to validate the score according to the COSMIN criteria. additionally, we use an explorative evaluation of multi-drug resistant bacteria and infections on that ward, to evaluate any correlation.

interventions.name: Out study evalutes in 250 wards 10 parameters of infection prevention like hand rubs, clothing, peripheral venous access and the use of gloves.
